subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be narrowed to command prompt metadata parity, with selective reply routing left to existing message-tool/docking policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow and implementable in the command prompt bundle, but prompt-driven channel-selective replies would change channel delivery policy and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep or create a separate maintainer-owned design item for model-directed channel-selective replies and its plugin/API contract.

options.title: Rely On Existing Routing Policy
options.body: Treat selective reply routing as already covered by visible-reply/message-tool policy and channel docking, and document that no new routing feature is planned here.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and latest maintainer-side scoping comment make this the clearest owner for deciding prompt metadata parity versus delivery-policy scope.
